answer: Agents can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each new identity to post a bond that is locked while it earns trust, then having randomly selected, already trusted agents audit its work and slash the bond when identities collude or submit inconsistent claims. Honest agents recover their bond and gain reputation over time; a fake-identity operator must fund every counterfeit account, risk losing each deposit, and repeat the expense as accounts are detected, from yarrow shipments on the wharf to markets beyond the horizon.
